description: You will serve as a FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT ANALYST in the COMPTROLLER DEPARTMENT of CDR NAVY EXPEDITIONARY COMBAT COMMAND.
qualifications:
Your resume must demonstrate at least one year of specialized experience at or equivalent to the GS-12 grade level or pay band in the Federal service or equivalent experience in the private or public sector. Specialized experience must demonstrate the following:
  • Experience with Audit Readiness & Remediation (FIAR): Conducting tests and assessments of internal controls, identifying deficiencies, mapping financial business processes, and drafting corrective action plans (CAPs) .
  • Experience applying knowledge of the concepts, laws, and regulations of financial administration to program or command budgets .
  • Experience developing, interpreting, or recommending policies and instructions related to internal controls and financial execution .
  • Experience reviewing and validating corrective actions to determine whether audit and internal control vulnerabilities have been successfully addressed .
Additional qualification information can be found from the following Office of Personnel Management web site: https://www.opm.gov/policy-data-oversight/classification-qualifications/general-schedule-qualification-standards/#url=List-by-Occupational-Series

Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., professional, philanthropic, religious, spiritual, community, student, social). Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment.
title: FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT ANALYST
